poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.ent:
Fingertip Incantations
Edit slots, shortcuts and layout
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.hot:
Mixed (default): slots 1–9 are the vanilla hotbar, with number keys, scrolling and pick block as usual; the row moves as one.
Fingertip: slots 1–9 can be bound, moved and deleted freely, and refill from the next stack.
Slots 10+ are shared. Switching never moves items or changes bindings.
Silver frames: vanilla · Gold frames: Fingertip
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.nat: Works as in vanilla; the row moves as one
These nine are the vanilla hotbar; bind skills and functions to other slots
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.off: Shows your off-hand item, hidden while it is empty. It can be moved, not deleted or bound.
The off-hand frame cannot be deleted; it can only be moved.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.nat: The vanilla hotbar uses this key; choose another
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sho: This key is currently used by vanilla or the wheel, so this slot is paused; its binding and position are kept
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.key: Saved, but %s isn't taken over (see Key takeover); this slot is paused.
Saved, but the middle button opens the radial menu; this slot is paused.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sho: %s isn't taken over (see Key takeover); paused, with binding and position kept.
The middle button opens the radial menu; paused, with binding and position kept.
Shortcut paused: %s. It resumes once the conflict is gone; the binding and position are kept.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.pau: it collides with a basic control
the whitelisted function %s uses the same key
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sna:
On: dragged slots line up with nearby ones at the chosen gap.
Off: drag freely. Arrow keys always nudge.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.ski: Classic: charcoal and brass. Starlight: silver-blue crystals. Poris: dark roses and gold. Applies to panels, buttons, wheel and HUD.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.dis:
All / hide empty / hide all. Only the picture changes; keys still work.
Missing items still show dimmed; the editor always shows every slot.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whi:
On: this mod keeps its own keys.
Off: use it through slots.
Basic controls and mixed-mode 1–9 win any key clash.
On. Slot(s) %s share its key and are paused until you turn this mod off again.
Unknown mod. Select a mod from the list.
No mods with identifiable key bindings found
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.lay:
Click a slot to set its key; drag to move it. Drag on empty space to select; Shift/Ctrl-click adds or removes. Move or arrange the selection together.
Tab hides the panels. Changes apply at once; deleting asks first.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.tak: F1–F9 can be bound to slots; keys dimmed below keep their usual function.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.use: When you right-click with an item held through a slot, other mods see its real inventory slot (Sophisticated Backpacks needs this to open a held backpack). Turn it off if a mod misbehaves.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.pic: No pick block in Fingertip mode; use Mixed mode with a hotbar slot chosen
A slot holds your hand; choose a hotbar slot to pick blocks
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.tak: A taken F3 no longer opens the debug screen; F3 combinations still work.
While E is taken over the wheel stays on, to open the inventory.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: On: middle mouse opens the wheel, and slots on middle mouse pause. Pick drag or click at the bottom left.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.rea: Drag in to bind · Drag to the clear area to clear · Tab shows the whole screen
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: Point at an action · Centre or Esc closes
· Click for one, hold to keep dropping; the wheel stays open
· Click for a stack; the wheel stays open
Release over an action to run it · Release in the centre to cancel

Drag: hold the middle button, release over an action to run it once, or in the centre to cancel; drops run once too.
Click: middle click opens the wheel; click an action to run it; drops can be clicked again, the wheel stays open.
Either way, the centre, right-click or Esc closes.
Fingertip Incantations is fixed at the bottom of the wheel.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.ena: Master switch. Off restores every key; your layout and bindings are kept.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: With E taken over the wheel opens the inventory, so it stays on; release E first.
Assign this action to the selected wedge.
Click a wedge, then choose an action. Positions match the in-game wheel.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.can: Tab hides all panels for a moment, so covered slots are easy to reach
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: Inventory is fixed at the top of the wheel.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.del: Slots, bindings and keys are removed; your items are unaffected.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.dra: Release to swap with slot %2$s (keys stay)
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.cle: Only the binding is cleared; the slot, its position and key stay, and items are unaffected.

Silver-blue rims with star crystals. Hover and selection brighten the same frame without moving the item.
Dark crimson, gold, roses and crystals. Every state keeps the same frame; selection lights up its gold rim.

Only hides mod function slots; skills and items still show and keys still work
